notes.title: Fist of Heaven & Hell is receiving a permanent discount!
notes.notes:
Today, Fist of Heaven & Hell is getting a permanent discount so that it’s more accessible to everyone! Also, stay tuned for upcoming game updates that will add new content.

Have fun and thank you so much for your continued support!

notes.title: Fist Of Heaven & Hell is out with a 15% discount!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that Fist Of Heaven & Hell is available right now for purchase on Steam! Be sure to take advantage of the 15% discount as a special launch promotion as it won't last long! 

If you want to contact me about bugs, comments, or give me any feedback about the game, you can do so in the Community Hub or by writing an email to [i][b][u]fistofheavenandhell@gmail.com[/u][/b][/i]

Be sure to write a review about the game on Steam since every single one is important and I'd love to hear what you have to say about Fist Of Heaven & Hell!

As a final note, I want everyone to keep in mind that I will be including more free content as time goes on so that you can get as much as you can from your purchase.

Have fun!
